description: This file defines the ConnectionObserver interface and its factory for a WebRTC streaming system within the Android Cuttlefish project. It specifies various virtual methods for handling device events, communication channels, and message sending related to device control, input events, and sensor data.

classes.name: ConnectionObserver
classes.description: Interface defining the boundary between device-specific code and shared WebRTC streaming code, with methods for handling various device events and communication channels.

classes.name: ConnectionObserverFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of ConnectionObserver.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Called when a connection is established.

methods.name: OnMouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse movement events with coordinates x and y.

methods.name: OnMouseButtonEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse button press or release events.

methods.name: OnTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input events with device label, position, and down state.

methods.name: OnMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles multi-touch events with a label, identifier, position, and size.

methods.name: OnKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard input events with keycode and down state.

methods.name: OnAdbChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when ADB channel is opened, with a sender function.

methods.name: OnControlChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when control channel is opened, with a sender function.

methods.name: OnCustomActionButton
methods.description: Handles custom button actions with command and button state.

methods.name: OnBluetoothChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when Bluetooth channel is opened, with message sender.

methods.name: OnSensorsChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when sensors channel is opened.

methods.name: OnLightsChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when lights channel is opened.

methods.name: OnLocationChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when location channel is opened.

methods.name: OnKmlLocationsChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when KML locations channel is opened.

methods.name: OnGpxLocationsChannelOpen
methods.description: Called when GPX locations channel is opened.
